title: Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
title_zh: 更优的视觉表示是否总能带来更出色的端到端自动驾驶性能？

paragraphs.en: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA .

paragraphs.en: End-to-end autonomous driving is considered a promising route to scalable real-world deployment ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Guan et al., 2026 ) . Within this pipeline, visual representations provide the planner with information about the environment, making the learning of high-quality visual representations an important research problem ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . As visual foundation models (VFMs) advance in semantic understanding and 3D geometry ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Carion et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , an increasing number of studies either use VFMs directly ( Sima et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Naeinian et al., 2026 ) or incorporate their pre-trained representations through distillation and representation alignment ( Strong et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . However, most studies focus on a single planner–VFM pairing ( Zuo et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and systematic comparisons of planning gains across different pairings remain limited. It remains unclear whether the advantages of VFMs on visual tasks consistently translate into improved driving performance.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端的自动驾驶被认为是实现可扩展的真实世界部署的一条有前景的路径（Chen 等人，2024a；Guan 等人，2026）。 在这一流程中，视觉表示为规划器提供有关环境的信息，因此学习高质量的视觉表示成为一个重要的研究问题（Jiang 等人，2023；Li 等人，2024）。 随着视觉基础模型（VFMs）在语义理解和三维几何方面的进步（Siméoni 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2025；Carion 等人，2025；Lin 等人，2025），越来越多的研究要么直接使用 VFMs（Sima 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2026a；Naeinian 等人，2026），要么通过蒸馏和表示对齐来整合其预训练表示（Strong 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026a；Xie 等人，2026）。 然而，大多数研究都集中在单一的规划器–VFM 组合上（Zuo 等人，2026b；Wang 等人，2026b），而不同组合之间规划增益的系统性比较仍然有限。 目前尚不清楚 VFMs 在视觉任务上的优势是否总能转化为驾驶性能的提升。

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we introduce ViRA, a VFM-guided representation alignment framework illustrated in Figure 1 (a). ViRA aligns the planner’s intermediate features with those of a frozen VFM target while keeping the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Using this framework, we compare different combinations of end-to-end planners and VFM targets on NAVSIM v2 ( Cao et al., 2025 ) and HUGSIM ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) . We find that VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across the diverse planners, but the gains depend on both the VFM target and planner design. We further examine these findings below, focusing on overall driving gains, the effects of VFM target selection, and the role of auxiliary perception supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这个问题，我们提出了 ViRA——一个由 VFM 引导的表示对齐框架，如图 1 (a) 所示。 ViRA 将规划器的中间特征与冻结的 VFM 目标模型的特征进行对齐，同时保持规划器架构和推理成本不变（Yu et al., 2025b；Singh et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a）。 利用该框架，我们在 NAVSIM v2（Cao et al., 2025）和 HUGSIM（Zhou et al., 2025a）上比较了端到端规划器与 VFM 目标模型的不同组合。 我们发现，由 VFM 引导的视觉表示能够持续提升各类规划器的驾驶性能，但性能增益既取决于 VFM 目标模型的选择，也取决于规划器的设计。 下文我们将进一步探讨这些发现，重点关注整体驾驶性能的提升、VFM 目标模型选择的影响以及辅助感知监督的作用。

paragraphs.en: VFM-guided visual representations improve end-to-end driving performance. As shown in Figure 1 (c-i), ViRA improves driving performance across regression-based ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) , diffusion-based ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , and scoring-based ( Feng et al., 2026 ) planners, yielding average gains of 7.9 and 8.6 EPDMS points over their respective baselines on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. These benefits extend to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM, where overall HD-Score improves by an average of 4.0 points. Figure 1 (b) shows that driving gains are accompanied by improved perception performance. To test whether the gains come from pre-training rather than loss regularization alone, we compare pre-trained and randomly initialized targets under the same alignment objectives. Randomly initialized targets fail to reproduce these perception and planning gains, supporting the importance of pre-trained VFM representations. This raises the question of whether VFMs with different pre-training objectives yield different planning benefits.

paragraphs.en: The choice of VFM target matters. As shown in Figure 1 (c-ii), gains for the same Rap ∗ ( Feng et al., 2026 ) architecture range from 6.6 to 12.1 EPDMS points across VFM targets (a 5.5-point spread), with DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) yielding the largest gain. Yet even when Rap ∗ uses DINOv3 as its pre-trained backbone, alignment to VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , a 3D geometric foundation model, further improves EPDMS from 83.8 to 86.3 (+2.5 points). This dependence on the VFM target also appears in TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) when trained without auxiliary perception supervision, with DINOv3 again performing best. With auxiliary perception supervision, however, TransFuser and DiffusionDrive ( Liao et al., 2025 ) achieve similar planning performance across these targets. We hypothesize that auxiliary perception supervision affects how planners learn from VFM targets.

paragraphs.en: Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection. To examine this factor, we compare TransFuser with and without auxiliary perception supervision. Across the same five VFM targets, planning gains over the respective baselines without representation alignment range from 5.2 to 5.7 EPDMS points with auxiliary supervision and from 3.8 to 6.5 points without it. As shown in Figure 1 (c-iii), removing auxiliary supervision widens the spread in gains across targets from 0.5 to 2.7 EPDMS points. More specifically, the highest score stays nearly unchanged, while the lowest drops from 88.8 to 86.4, indicating that auxiliary supervision mainly compensates for the less effective targets. These results show that, in this setting, auxiliary perception supervision narrows the differences in gains across alignment targets, making planning performance less sensitive to VFM target selection.

sents.en: To examine this factor, we compare TransFuser with and without auxiliary perception supervision.
sents.zh: 为了研究这一因素，我们对比了使用和不使用辅助感知监督的 TransFuser。

sents.en: Across the same five VFM targets, planning gains over the respective baselines without representation alignment range from 5.2 to 5.7 EPDMS points with auxiliary supervision and from 3.8 to 6.5 points without it.
sents.zh: 在相同的五个 VFM 目标上，与没有表示对齐的基线相比，使用辅助监督时规划增益从 5.2 到 5.7 EPDMS 分不等，而不使用辅助监督时则为 3.8 到 6.5 分。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 1 (c-iii), removing auxiliary supervision widens the spread in gains across targets from 0.5 to 2.7 EPDMS points.
sents.zh: 如图 1 (c-iii) 所示，移除辅助监督会使不同目标之间的增益差异从 0.5 扩大到 2.7 EPDMS 分。

sents.en: More specifically, the highest score stays nearly unchanged, while the lowest drops from 88.8 to 86.4, indicating that auxiliary supervision mainly compensates for the less effective targets.
sents.zh: 更具体地说，最高得分几乎保持不变，而最低得分则从 88.8 降至 86.4，这表明辅助监督主要补偿了效果较弱的目标。

sents.en: These results show that, in this setting, auxiliary perception supervision narrows the differences in gains across alignment targets, making planning performance less sensitive to VFM target selection.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，在此设置中，辅助感知监督缩小了不同对齐目标之间的增益差异，使规划性能对 VFM 目标选择的敏感度降低。

paragraphs.en: We systematically study the driving benefits of pre-trained VFM representations across planners and targets using ViRA, a planner-agnostic experimental framework that preserves the deployed planner architecture and inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ViRA——一个不依赖特定规划器的实验框架，通过保留实际部署的规划器架构和推理成本，系统性地研究了预训练 VFM 表示在不同规划器和目标上的驱动优势。

paragraphs.en: We show that VFM target selection affects planning performance, while auxiliary perception supervision narrows performance differences across targets, highlighting the importance of considering target selection and planner supervision jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，VFM 目标选择会影响规划性能，而辅助感知监督则能缩小不同目标之间的性能差异，这凸显了同时考虑目标选择和规划器监督的重要性。

paragraphs.en: NAVSIM ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) is a data-driven, non-reactive simulation and benchmarking framework for autonomous driving built on OpenScene ( OpenScene Contributors, 2023 ) and nuPlan ( Karnchanachari et al., 2024 ) . We use navtrain for training and evaluate models on two NAVSIM v2 ( Cao et al., 2025 ) benchmarks, navtest and navhard. Both benchmarks adopt the rule-based planning metric EPDMS ( Li et al., 2025a ) , whose sub-metrics include No-at-fault Collisions (NC), Drivable Area Compliance (DAC), Driving Direction Compliance (DDC), Traffic Light Compliance (TLC), Time-to-Collision (TTC), Ego Progress (EP), Lane Keeping (LK), History Comfort (HC), and Extended Comfort (EC).
paragraphs.zh: NAVSIM（Dauner 等人，2024）是一个基于 OpenScene（OpenScene 贡献者，2023）和 nuPlan（Karnchanachari 等人，2024）构建的、面向自动驾驶的数据驱动型非反应式模拟与基准测试框架。 我们使用 navtrain 进行训练，并在两个 NAVSIM v2（Cao 等人，2025）基准测试——navtest 和 navhard 上对模型进行评估。 这两个基准测试均采用基于规则的规划指标 EPDMS（Li 等人，2025a），其子指标包括无责任碰撞（NC）、可驾驶区域合规性（DAC）、行驶方向合规性（DDC）、交通信号灯合规性（TLC）、碰撞时间（TTC）、自身车辆进展（EP）、车道保持（LK）、历史舒适性（HC）和扩展舒适性（EC）。

paragraphs.en: HUGSIM ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) is a real-time, photorealistic closed-loop simulator that reconstructs 3D scenes from captured RGB images with 3D Gaussian Splatting and updates ego and actor states at each step from the planner output, so that surrounding vehicles react to the ego. We evaluate planners trained only on NAVSIM in a zero-shot manner on scenarios grouped into four difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extreme. The evaluation metric is HD-Score, which weights route completion (RC) by per-step safety and comfort scores. Beyond planning scores, we use mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) over seven BEV semantic classes to measure TransFuser’s perception performance and assess the quality of its learned representations. More details are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: HUGSIM（Zhou 等人，2025a）是一款实时、逼真的闭环模拟器，它通过 3D 高斯泼溅技术从捕获的 RGB 图像重建 3D 场景，并在每一步根据规划器的输出更新自身和周围智能体的状态，从而使周围的车辆对自身的行为做出反应。 我们在零样本条件下，将仅使用 NAVSIM 训练的规划器评估在四个难度等级（简单、中等、困难和极端）的场景中。 评估指标为 HD-Score，该指标通过每一步的安全性和舒适度得分对路线完成度（RC）进行加权计算。 除了规划得分外，我们还利用七个 BEV 语义类别的平均交并比（mIoU）来衡量 TransFuser 的感知性能，并评估其学习到的表示质量。 更多细节请参见附录 B。

sents.zh: 我们在零样本条件下，将仅使用 NAVSIM 训练的规划器评估在四个难度等级（简单、中等、困难和极端）的场景中。

sents.en: The evaluation metric is HD-Score, which weights route completion (RC) by per-step safety and comfort scores.
sents.zh: 评估指标为 HD-Score，该指标通过每一步的安全性和舒适度得分对路线完成度（RC）进行加权计算。

sents.en: Beyond planning scores, we use mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) over seven BEV semantic classes to measure TransFuser’s perception performance and assess the quality of its learned representations.
sents.zh: 除了规划得分外，我们还利用七个 BEV 语义类别的平均交并比（mIoU）来衡量 TransFuser 的感知性能，并评估其学习到的表示质量。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that VFM-guided representation alignment consistently improves driving performance across three representative planners. With ViRA, TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) , DiffusionDrive ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , and Rap ∗ ( Feng et al., 2026 ) achieve EPDMS gains of 5.4, 7.4, and 10.9 points over their respective baselines. DAC and LK show substantial improvements, reflecting gains in drivable-area compliance and lane keeping, respectively. Both capabilities are closely tied to visual perception. These improvements suggest that the benefits of VFM-guided visual representations extend across different planner architectures in standard driving scenarios.

paragraphs.en: The benefits extend to challenging driving scenarios: all three planners achieve higher EPDMS with ViRA on navhard (Table 2 ). Notably, although Rap ∗ already achieves the highest baseline EPDMS among the three planners, representation alignment further improves its score from 32.8 to 49.2, a gain of 16.4 points. DAC and DDC also improve, reflecting better drivable-area compliance and driving direction compliance in challenging scenarios. These improvements highlight the value of VFM-guided visual representations even for the strongest evaluated planner in challenging scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 这些优势也体现在具有挑战性的驾驶场景中：在 navhard 数据集上，三种规划器结合 ViRA 都能实现更高的 EPDMS（见表 2）。 值得注意的是，尽管 Rap ∗ 在这三种规划器中已经实现了最高的基线 EPDMS，但通过表示对齐，其得分从 32.8 进一步提升到 49.2，提升了 16.4 分。 DAC 和 DDC 也有所提升，反映出在具有挑战性的场景中，对可驾驶区域和驾驶方向的遵循性得到了改善。 这些改进凸显了 VFM 引导的视觉表示的价值，即便对于评估中最强的规划器而言，在具有挑战性的场景中也是如此。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the gains extend beyond NAVSIM, we evaluate NAVSIM-trained planners on the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) without further training. As shown in Table 3 , ViRA improves the overall HD-Score of TransFuser, DiffusionDrive and Rap ∗ by 2.7, 6.4 and 3.0 points, respectively. Together with the NAVSIM results, these zero-shot gains support our finding that VFM-guided visual representations do improve driving performance across different benchmarks and evaluation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估这些增益是否超越了 NAVSIM，我们在无需进一步训练的情况下，使用闭环 HUGSIM 基准测试（Zhou et al., 2025a）来评估通过 NAVSIM 训练的智能体规划器。 如表 3 所示，ViRA 分别将 TransFuser、DiffusionDrive 和 Rap ∗ 的整体 HD-Score 提升了 2.7、6.4 和 3.0 分。 结合 NAVSIM 的结果来看，这些零样本增益支持我们的发现：由 VFM 引导的视觉表示确实能够提升不同基准测试和评估设置下的驾驶性能。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether the driving gains are accompanied by improved perception, we analyze BEV segmentation and attention maps. Figure 6 (a) shows that ViRA improves TransFuser’s BEV segmentation mIoU by 0.5–3.0 points across the evaluated VFM targets. The t-SNE visualizations in Figure 2 suggest that ViRA shifts the representations of TransFuser and Rap ∗ toward those of the DVGT target in the t-SNE embedding space. The qualitative examples in Figure 3 further illustrate improvements in BEV predictions and planned trajectories, together with changes in attention to surrounding road users. These results provide evidence that alignment with high-quality VFM representations improves perception alongside driving performance.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验驾驶性能的提升是否伴随着感知能力的增强，我们分析了BEV分割和注意力图。 图6(a)显示，在评估的VFM目标上，ViRA将TransFuser的BEV分割mIoU提升了0.5至3.0个点。 图2中的t-SNE可视化结果表明，在t-SNE嵌入空间中，ViRA使TransFuser和Rap ∗的表示向DVGT目标的表示靠拢。 图3中的定性示例进一步展示了BEV预测和规划轨迹的改进，以及对环境道路参与者的注意力变化。 这些结果证明，与高质量VFM表示的对齐能够同时提升感知能力和驾驶性能。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the gains depend on VFM pre-training, we replace the pre-trained target with a randomly initialized one while retaining the same alignment objectives. As shown in Table 4 , random-target alignment reduces TransFuser’s BEV segmentation mIoU from 36.4 to 30.7, whereas alignment with pre-trained DVGT increases it to 39.1. The same pattern holds for driving performance: random-target alignment lowers EPDMS by 1.6 points for TransFuser and 1.7 points for Rap ∗ , while the pre-trained target improves both planners (Table 5 ). These results support the importance of pre-trained visual knowledge: applying the same alignment objectives to random representations does not reproduce the gains observed with pre-trained VFM representations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验这些增益是否依赖于 VFM 预训练，我们在保留相同对齐目标的同时，将预训练的目标模型替换为随机初始化的模型。 如表 4 所示，使用随机目标的对齐方式使 TransFuser 的 BEV 分割 mIoU 从 36.4 降至 30.7，而使用预训练 DVGT 的对齐方式则将其提升至 39.1。 驾驶性能也呈现出相同趋势：随机目标对齐使 TransFuser 的 EPDMS 降低 1.6 分，Rap ∗ 降低 1.7 分；而预训练目标则提升了两种规划器（见表 5）。 这些结果支持了预训练视觉知识的重要性：将相同的对齐目标应用于随机表示时，无法重现使用预训练 VFM 表示所观察到的增益。

paragraphs.en: A practical question is whether these representation gains require replacing the planner encoder with a larger VFM at inference. Figure 4 compares ViRA with direct VFM backbone replacement in terms of planning performance, inference latency, and parameter count. Latency is measured on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU. DVGT-guided alignment improves EPDMS from 72.8 to 83.7 while retaining the baseline latency of 20 ms and parameter count of 69M. This nearly matches the strongest evaluated backbone replacement, DINOv3-L, which achieves 83.8 EPDMS but requires 65 ms and 351M parameters. Since the VFM and alignment heads are used only during training, ViRA enables the planner to benefit from pre-trained visual representations without changing its deployed architecture or increasing inference cost.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 (c-ii), changing only the representation alignment target for the perception-free Rap ∗ yields EPDMS scores ranging from 79.4 to 84.9, a spread of 5.5 points. This difference is comparable to the gains from many method-level improvements. These results highlight the importance of alignment target selection, with DINOv3, which learns from more general data, providing the largest planning gain in this setting. To further examine whether VFMs with different pre-training objectives provide complementary representations, we use Rap ∗ with a DINOv3-L backbone as the baseline and introduce alignment to VGGT, a VFM trained for 3D geometry.

Thus, even when the backbone already provides strong semantic representations, alignment to a geometry-focused VFM can further improve planning performance. These results suggest that alignment target selection deserves careful consideration, as its benefits may depend on the complementarity between the target VFM and the planner’s existing representations.

paragraphs.en: Extending the experiments from the preceding subsection to perception-based planners, we find that TransFuser and DiffusionDrive are less sensitive to the choice of VFM target. Across VFM targets, EPDMS varies by only 0.5 points for TransFuser (88.8 to 89.3) and 0.6 points for DiffusionDrive (91.3 to 91.9), compared with 5.5 points for the perception-free Rap ∗ . One important difference between these planners is the use of auxiliary perception supervision. TransFuser and DiffusionDrive learn planner representations with BEV segmentation and agent detection supervision, whereas Rap ∗ does not. We therefore hypothesize that auxiliary perception supervision reduces the sensitivity of the planner to VFM target selection.
paragraphs.zh: 将前一小节的实验扩展到基于感知的规划器后，我们发现 TransFuser 和 DiffusionDrive 对 VFM 目标的选择不太敏感。 在不同 VFM 目标下，TransFuser 的 EPDMS 仅变化 0.5 分（从 88.8 到 89.3），DiffusionDrive 的变化为 0.6 分（从 91.3 到 91.9），而无需感知的 Rap ∗ 则变化了 5.5 分。 这些规划器之间的一个重要区别在于是否使用了辅助感知监督。 TransFuser 和 DiffusionDrive 通过 BEV 分割和智能体检测监督来学习规划器表示，而 Rap ∗ 则没有这样做。 因此，我们假设辅助感知监督降低了规划器对 VFM 目标选择的敏感度。

sents.en: Across VFM targets, EPDMS varies by only 0.5 points for TransFuser (88.8 to 89.3) and 0.6 points for DiffusionDrive (91.3 to 91.9), compared with 5.5 points for the perception-free Rap ∗ .

sents.en: One important difference between these planners is the use of auxiliary perception supervision.
sents.zh: 这些规划器之间的一个重要区别在于是否使用了辅助感知监督。

sents.en: TransFuser and DiffusionDrive learn planner representations with BEV segmentation and agent detection supervision, whereas Rap ∗ does not.
sents.zh: TransFuser 和 DiffusionDrive 通过 BEV 分割和智能体检测监督来学习规划器表示，而 Rap ∗ 则没有这样做。

sents.en: We therefore hypothesize that auxiliary perception supervision reduces the sensitivity of the planner to VFM target selection.
sents.zh: 因此，我们假设辅助感知监督降低了规划器对 VFM 目标选择的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: To test this hypothesis, we compare TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) with and without auxiliary perception supervision across five alignment targets: DVGT ( Zuo et al., 2026a ) , VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Figure 6 (b), EPDMS ranges from 88.8 to 89.3 with auxiliary supervision. Removing this supervision expands the range to 86.4 to 89.1, increasing the spread from 0.5 to 2.7 points. Examining the endpoints of these ranges provides further insight: after removing auxiliary supervision, the maximum score remains nearly unchanged (89.3 to 89.1), whereas the minimum drops substantially (88.8 to 86.4). This indicates that auxiliary supervision mainly compensates for the less effective targets. Across these targets, TransFuser’s BEV segmentation results under auxiliary supervision show a broadly similar ordering to its planning results without auxiliary supervision. Overall, these controlled comparisons show that auxiliary perception supervision reduces TransFuser’s sensitivity to VFM target selection.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end autonomous driving learns planning and control directly from sensory inputs within a unified framework ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . Joint optimization can mitigate cascading errors between separately trained modules and facilitate learning from large-scale driving data, making end-to-end autonomous driving a promising route toward scalable real-world deployment ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Jia et al., 2024 ; Guan et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies focus on improving policy heads ( Liao et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , introducing auxiliary perception supervision ( Strong et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Xing et al., 2025 ) , and scaling training data through synthetic scene generation and augmentation ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026c ) . Despite this progress, how visual representation quality contributes to planning gains remains insufficiently understood. Some recent methods enhance visual representations for driving with semantic and geometric priors from pre-trained VFMs ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . These methods demonstrate benefits within specific systems, but provide limited guidance on how the gains vary across VFM targets and planner designs. Complementing these directions, we study when better visual representations improve planning performance.

paragraphs.en: Learning visual representations that capture scene semantics and spatial structure is crucial for end-to-end autonomous driving ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . To enrich these representations, recent driving studies turn to VFMs pre-trained on large-scale visual data, drawing on their capabilities in semantics ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Carion et al., 2025 ) , depth ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , and 3D geometry ( Zuo et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . These VFMs are used through visual backbone replacement ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Naeinian et al., 2026 ) , auxiliary supervision from VFM predictions ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Strong et al., 2026 ) , or feature integration within task-specific architectures and training objectives ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies show that representation alignment, which supervises intermediate features with frozen visual representations, can improve training efficiency and task performance ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026a ) . iREPA ( Singh et al., 2026 ) further shows that the spatial structure of target representations predicts image generation quality better than their ImageNet classification accuracy. In end-to-end autonomous driving, how planner architecture and auxiliary perception supervision shape the benefits of VFM-guided representations remains unclear. We use representation alignment as a controlled experimental interface to study these interactions across planners and VFM targets.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we systematically study when VFM-guided visual representations improve end-to-end autonomous driving, using ViRA as an experimental interface that keeps the planner’s architecture and inference cost unchanged. Experiments across planners and benchmarks show consistent driving gains, with benefits extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. VFM target selection affects these gains, and alignment to a different VFM can further improve planners that already use pre-trained VFM backbones. Controlled comparisons on TransFuser further show that auxiliary perception supervision narrows performance differences across VFM targets. These results highlight the importance of considering VFM target selection and planner supervision jointly. Guided by this analysis, we develop ViRA-Diffusion with DINOv3 alignment and no auxiliary perception supervision, achieving 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest. Future work will examine whether these findings extend to additional planner architectures and other physical intelligence tasks involving decision-making.

sents.en: Experiments across planners and benchmarks show consistent driving gains, with benefits extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation.
sents.zh: 跨多种规划器和基准测试的实验表明，驾驶性能持续提升，且这种优势也延伸到了零样本闭环评估中。

sents.en: VFM target selection affects these gains, and alignment to a different VFM can further improve planners that already use pre-trained VFM backbones.
sents.zh: VFM 目标的选择会影响这些性能提升，而与不同的 VFM 对齐还能进一步改善那些已使用预训练 VFM 主干网络的规划器。

sents.en: Controlled comparisons on TransFuser further show that auxiliary perception supervision narrows performance differences across VFM targets.
sents.zh: 在 TransFuser 上进行的受控比较进一步表明，辅助感知监督能够缩小不同 VFM 目标之间的性能差异。

sents.en: These results highlight the importance of considering VFM target selection and planner supervision jointly.
sents.zh: 这些结果凸显了同时考虑 VFM 目标选择和规划器监督的重要性。

sents.en: Guided by this analysis, we develop ViRA-Diffusion with DINOv3 alignment and no auxiliary perception supervision, achieving 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest.
sents.zh: 基于这一分析，我们开发了 ViRA-Diffusion，采用 DINOv3 对齐且无需辅助感知监督，在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 上取得了 92.3 EPDMS 的成绩。

sents.en: Future work will examine whether these findings extend to additional planner architectures and other physical intelligence tasks involving decision-making.
sents.zh: 未来的工作将研究这些发现是否适用于其他规划器架构以及涉及决策的其他物理智能任务。

paragraphs.en: To transfer driving-relevant knowledge from VFMs to planner encoders, we align their representations from two complementary perspectives: spatial distribution and scene semantic structure. As shown in Figure S.1 , Spatial Dependency Alignment (SDA) aligns the spatial attention distribution of the planner representation with that of the VFM representation, encouraging the planner to capture fine-grained spatial dependencies. Scene Semantic Alignment (SSA) further aligns the global latent representations of the E2E planner and the VFMs through a bidirectional contrastive objective, preserving scene-level semantic consistency across training samples. Together, these two objectives improve the representation quality of the E2E planner encoder for downstream trajectory planning.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将驾驶相关的知识从 VFM 迁移到规划器编码器，我们从两个互补的视角对其表示进行对齐：空间分布和场景语义结构。 如图 S.1 所示，空间依赖对齐（SDA）将规划器表示的空间注意力分布与 VFM 表示的空间注意力分布进行对齐，从而促使规划器捕捉精细的空间依赖关系。 场景语义对齐（SSA）则通过双向对比目标，进一步对齐 E2E 规划器和 VFM 的全局潜在表示，从而在训练样本中保持场景级别的语义一致性。 这两个目标共同提升了 E2E 规划器编码器在下游轨迹规划任务中的表示质量。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate driving performance on navtest and navhard using NAVSIM v2 ( Cao et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 NAVSIM v2（Cao 等人，2025）在 navtest 和 navhard 上评估驾驶性能。 navtest 评估涵盖单个阶段中的 12,146 个真实世界场景，从而对多种驾驶条件下的表现进行全面评估。 对于 navhard，我们遵循与 SimScale（Tian 等人，2026）相同的两阶段评估设置，使用 244 个具有挑战性的真实世界场景以及通过 3D 高斯泼溅技术渲染的 4,164 个合成后续场景。 两项评估均使用扩展预测驾驶员模型得分（EPDMS）（Li 等人，2025a；Cao 等人，2025），该得分将乘法惩罚项与驾驶质量得分的加权平均值相结合。

paragraphs.en: We provide additional implementation details of the representation alignment module. paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了表示对齐模块的额外实现细节。 在我们的实验中，我们将 DVGT（Zuo 等人，2026a）、VGGT（Wang 等人，2025）、DINOv3（Siméoni 等人，2025）、SAM3（Carion 等人，2025）和 DA3（Lin 等人，2025）的官方公开检查点用作冻结的 VFM 目标，并在整个训练过程中保持所有 VFM 参数冻结。 对于所有 VFM 目标，我们使用其任务特定预测头之前的中间表示，而非最终的任务输出。 这种设计避免了对显式伪标签的依赖，而是将 VFM 学到的视觉表示迁移到规划器编码器中。

paragraphs.en: For DVGT ( Zuo et al., 2026a ) , we follow its original feature extraction design and take the multi-level features before the DPT prediction head. Specifically, we extract four intermediate token features from the DVGT aggregator, fuse them with learnable weights, and reshape the patch tokens into a spatial feature map. For other VFM targets, we follow the same principle and use the corresponding feature maps before their prediction heads.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DVGT（Zuo 等人，2026a），我们遵循其原始的特征提取设计，并采用 DPT 预测头之前的多层级特征。 具体而言，我们从 DVGT 聚合器中提取四个中间标记特征，使用可学习的权重对其进行融合，并将块标记重塑为空间特征图。 对于其他 VFM 目标，我们遵循相同的原则，并使用其预测头之前对应的特征图。

paragraphs.en: Given the planner feature 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} and the VFM feature 𝐅 t \mathbf{F}^{t} , we first resize 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} to the spatial resolution of 𝐅 t \mathbf{F}^{t} . Both features are then projected into a shared latent space by lightweight 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolutional projection heads. The projected features are used to compute the spatial distribution alignment loss and the semantic consistency loss described in Appendix A.2 . The VFM and alignment heads are used only during training and discarded after training, introducing no additional inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 给定规划器特征 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} 和 VFM 特征 𝐅 t \mathbf{F}^{t}，我们首先将 𝐅 s \mathbf{F}^{s} 调整到与 𝐅 t \mathbf{F}^{t} 相同的空间分辨率。 随后，这两个特征通过轻量级的 1 × 1 1{\times}1 卷积投影头被映射到一个共享的潜在空间。 这些经过投影的特征用于计算附录 A.2 中描述的空间分布对齐损失和语义一致性损失。 VFM 和对齐头仅在训练阶段使用，训练结束后即被丢弃，因此不会带来额外的推理成本。

paragraphs.en: To validate the effectiveness of the latent alignment objective, we conduct an ablation study on TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) with different alignment objectives. We consider representative losses for feature-level, distribution-level, and contrastive supervision, and compare different combinations for spatial and semantic alignment ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . As shown in Table S.2 , jointly aligning spatial dependencies and semantic consistency generally yields better planning performance than using a single alignment objective. Among all combinations, KL divergence for spatial alignment and contrastive loss for semantic alignment achieve the best performance, reaching an EPDMS of 89.0.

paragraphs.en: This section provides additional quantitative results for the VFM-target analysis. We evaluate ViRA on both TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) and Rap ∗ ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Across the five targets used in the main comparison, ViRA improves TransFuser by 5.2–5.7 EPDMS and Rap* by 6.6–12.1 EPDMS (Tables S.3 and S.5 ). paragraphs.en: To test whether the gains depend on VFM pre-training, we replace the pre-trained target with a randomly initialized VFM target while retaining the same alignment objectives. Applying the same alignment objectives to random features therefore does not reproduce the gains observed with pre-trained VFM representations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验这些增益是否依赖于 VFM 预训练，我们将预训练的目标替换为随机初始化的 VFM 目标，同时保留相同的对齐目标。 如表 S.3 和 S.5 所示，使用随机目标的对齐方式使 EPDMS 在 TransFuser 上下降了 1.6 分，在 Rap ∗ 上下降了 1.7 分。 预训练的 DVGT 提升了两种规划器，分别提高了 +5.4 分和 +10.9 分。 因此，将相同的对齐目标应用于随机特征时，无法重现使用预训练 VFM 表示所观察到的增益。

paragraphs.en: Although ViRA improves representation quality and downstream planning performance, challenging failure cases remain. For perception-free planners Figure S.6 , different VFM targets exhibit slightly different failure patterns, suggesting that their representations may differ in subtle but meaningful ways and lead to small performance variations. For perception-based planners Figure S.7 , even when ViRA produces more complete BEV semantic maps, the planned trajectory may still fail to follow the human expert in challenging scenarios. These cases show that high-quality visual representations are fundamental, but not a silver bullet for end-to-end autonomous driving. Robust planning still requires better trajectory decoding, temporal reasoning, interaction modeling, and decision-making under uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ViRA 提升了表示质量和下游规划性能，但仍然存在一些具有挑战性的失败案例。 对于无需感知的规划器（图 S.6），不同的 VFM 目标表现出略微不同的失败模式，这表明它们的表示可能在细微但重要的方面存在差异，并导致性能出现微小变化。 对于基于感知的规划器（图 S.7），即使 ViRA 生成了更完整的 BEV 语义地图，在复杂场景下，规划出的轨迹仍可能无法跟随人类专家的轨迹。 这些案例表明，高质量的视觉表示是基础，但并非端到端自动驾驶的万能解决方案。 稳健的规划仍然需要更优的轨迹解码、时序推理、交互建模以及不确定性下的决策能力。

paragraphs.en: Although ViRA introduces no additional inference overhead, it relies on external frozen VFM representations during training. Extracting and storing VFM representations may introduce extra training cost, especially when using large-scale VFMs or high-resolution multi-view inputs. A practical future direction is to reduce this cost through feature caching, lightweight VFM distillation, or selective alignment over only the most informative layers and spatial regions. This would make VFM-guided representation alignment more scalable for larger datasets and more diverse planner architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ViRA 没有引入额外的推理开销，但在训练过程中它依赖外部的冻结 VFM 表示。 提取和存储 VFM 表示可能会带来额外的训练成本，尤其是在使用大规模 VFM 或高分辨率多视角输入时。 一个实用的未来方向是通过特征缓存、轻量级 VFM 蒸馏，或仅对最具信息价值的层和空间区域进行选择性对齐来降低这一成本。 这将使由 VFM 引导的表示对齐在更大数据集和更多样化的规划器架构上更具可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: This work evaluates ViRA on three representative E2E planners, on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, and in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. It does not cover multi-modal sensor fusion, vision-language-action models, or real-vehicle deployment. Further validation on a wider set of planners and real-world data is needed to assess how far the observed planner-dependent conversion from representation quality to planning gains generalizes.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究在 NAVSIM v2 的 navtest 和 navhard 测试集上，以及在 HUGSIM 上的零样本闭环评估中，对 ViRA 在三种具有代表性的端到端规划器上的表现进行了评估。 研究未涵盖多模态传感器融合、视觉-语言-动作模型或真实车辆的部署应用。 需要在更广泛的规划器集合和真实世界数据上进一步验证，以评估所观察到的、依赖于规划器的从表示质量到规划性能的提升在多大程度上具有泛化性。

paragraphs.en: By improving the visual representations used by E2E planners, ViRA may contribute to safer and more reliable autonomous driving systems. Meanwhile, the use of large-scale VFMs also raises potential concerns. VFMs may inherit biases from their pre-training data, including geographical, weather, cultural, and traffic-distribution biases. If such biases are transferred to autonomous driving planners without careful validation, they may cause degraded performance in underrepresented regions or rare safety-critical scenarios. Therefore, we believe that VFM-guided planning should be accompanied by rigorous evaluation across diverse environments, transparent failure analysis, and safety-oriented validation before real-world deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 通过改进 E2E 规划器所使用的视觉表示，ViRA 或有助于构建更安全、更可靠的自动驾驶系统。 与此同时，使用大规模 VFM 也引发了潜在的担忧。 VFM 可能会从其预训练数据中继承偏见，包括地理、天气、文化和交通分布方面的偏见。 如果未经仔细验证就将此类偏见转移到自动驾驶规划器中，它们可能会导致在代表性不足的区域或罕见的安全关键场景中性能下降。 因此，我们认为，在真实世界部署之前，VFM 引导的规划应伴随跨多样化环境的严格评估、透明的故障分析以及以安全为导向的验证。

paragraphs.en: All training and evaluation are conducted on publicly available datasets and benchmarks, including nuPlan ( Karnchanachari et al., 2024 ) , OpenScene ( OpenScene Contributors, 2023 ) , and NAVSIM v2 ( Cao et al., 2025 ) . We use these datasets only for research purposes and follow their official licenses and terms of use. We adopt several publicly available VFMs as VFM targets, including DVGT ( Zuo et al., 2026a ) , VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , and DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . DVGT is released under the Apache License 2.0. VGGT, DINOv3, and SAM3 are used under their respective official licenses. For DA3, we follow the license associated with the specific released model checkpoint used in our experiments. We also build upon publicly available E2E planners, including Rap ∗ ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , DiffusionDrive ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , and TransFuser ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) . Rap ∗ is released under the Apache License 2.0, while DiffusionDrive and TransFuser are released under the MIT License. We do not redistribute third-party datasets, model weights, or checkpoints. All third-party assets are used in accordance with their corresponding licenses. Our released code will include proper attribution and license notices for all used assets.
